blocking.title: The N27 fix breaks make test: the fake sandbox leaves a <workspace>.tmp directory in the validator's work root, which test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default forbids, so G1 and G3 fail at faf22c5
blocking.evidence: tests/bench/fakes.py:79-81 sets self.tmp = workspace.parent / f"{workspace.name}.tmp", run() creates it on every command (tests/bench/fakes.py:98) and passes it as TMPDIR (:102), and nothing removes it; the validator removes only the workspace itself (src/receipts/bench/validate.py:505-521). tests/bench/test_validate.py:149-152 (test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default, not marked slow) asserts that the work root is empty after validating phases baseline and m1, and now fails with 'AssertionError: assert not [.../work/py-toy-greet-m1.tmp, .../work/py-toy-greet-baseline.tmp]'. Observed: python tools/ship_check.py --fast on a fresh clone of faf22c5 gives G1 FAIL 'make test failed (exit 2)' (1 failed, 4478 passed, 75 deselected) and G3 FAIL, 6/14 against 8/14 at cec6701; the Python 3.11 leg of tools/prepush.sh for faf22c5 ends 'PREPUSH: FAIL make ci on fresh clone of faf22c5... (do not push)' with '1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped' and the same FAILED test, and the Python 3.12 leg ends the same way ("1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped", PREPUSH: FAIL, "312 exit 1"; its 4 skips are Docker tests); the test alone fails at faf22c5 on two runs in a scratch clone and passes at cec6701. GitHub CI would fail the same way. The results this changes are reported as passing: STATUS.md:17 and :19 (G1 and G3 PASS), STATUS.md:32 and README.md:312-313 (G1 to G4 pass), docs/REPORT.md:674-679 ('Built and tested at HEAD ... make ci passes on a fresh clone on Python 3.11 and 3.12 before a push'), and docs/REVIEW_LOG.md:37-38 records this change as the N27 fix. Fix it without reopening N27 and without relaxing the test, for example by giving each command a fresh private temporary directory that the fake removes when the command ends, as the bubblewrap backend gives every command an empty private /tmp (src/receipts/sandbox/bwrap.py:7, 133).

nonblocking.title: The review files drift by design (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: docs/REVIEW_LOG.md is not in ALLOWED_DRIFT (tools/review.py:34), and validate() (tools/review.py:84-87) requires every non-blocking id of a review to be listed there at HEAD (D10). This review raises no new non-blocking id, so tools/review.py --validate-only accepts it for faf22c5 and for a commit that changes only artifacts/review/, STATUS.md, or docs/LOG.md, and prints REVIEW: BLOCK because B9 is open. The B9 fix changes tests/, so G12 then needs a review of the fixing commit.

nonblocking.title: G5 does not read the E0 blindness audit
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: tools/ship_check.py has no reference to blindness (grep count 0); only tools/e0.py merge enforces that the seeded-report writers never saw src/receipts/claims/.

nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: prereg/0001-e1-main-study.md says the analyses record the evaluation's attempt number and list every attempt when it is not the first; src/receipts/study/results.py reads neither artifacts/e0/heldout_attempts.jsonl nor the attempt number. Fix before the freeze.

nonblocking.title: The smoke summary's provenance names neither the command that wrote it nor a commit that holds its inputs
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: artifacts/exploratory/smoke_outcomes.json provenance.command is a temporary --out path under /tmp, and git_sha is 3cdda50, whose tree lacks the D71 run first committed in 922cc0d. The 40 input hashes are right, and freshness ignores both keys by design (D56).

nonblocking.title: The re-derivations rest on tool code that no gate binds
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: check_rederived (tools/ship_check.py:4081) trusts the exit status of the clone's tools/bank_study.py --check, rescored_heldout (2760) the tools/e0.py recheck wrapper, and check_derivation (4119) receipts.report.derived, tools/analyze.py, tools/analyze_e4.py, and tools/run_judges.py; none is held unchanged since a freeze (the D57 residual).

nonblocking.title: Documentation statements that are not exact (new evidence)
nonblocking.evidence: Items (i) to (l) are fixed (see resolved). New evidence: (m) docs/REPORT.md:589, rewritten in faf22c5, says each CORRECTIONS.md entry 'names the file and section it corrects', but CORRECTIONS.md:134 ('The headline figure') names neither a file nor a section, and CORRECTIONS.md:46 and :72 name files but no section; the entry for this change (CORRECTIONS.md:87) says 'each entry names its file', which is closer but still misses :134. A corrected sentence in a results document needs a CORRECTIONS.md entry.

nonblocking.title: ship_check accepts a shallow clone outside G11 (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: only tools/prereg.py:471-475 refuses a shallow clone; ship_check's pre-phase does not, so the history checks of G5, G6, G7, and G9 (for example require_unchanged_runs, tools/ship_check.py:3970) would walk truncated history in one. This checkout has its full history.

nonblocking.title: G5 compares earlier held-out attempts by instrument code only, not by requirement texts or claim-type counts
nonblocking.evidence: Unchanged: heldout_attempt (tools/ship_check.py:2660) compares earlier held-out attempts by instrument files only; task_requirements (src/receipts/evaluation/e0.py:2501) reads requirement texts at HEAD, outside SCORING_PATHS (e0.py:86), and log_attempt (e0.py:2696) records neither requirement digests nor claim-type counts. Fix before any held-out scoring (the open item of D69).

nonblocking.title: The demo card's labels come from each fixture's meta.json, which nothing compares with the banked run (remaining part)
nonblocking.evidence: The ledger part is fixed (see resolved). The new test (tests/repo_tools/test_record_demo.py:82-93) compares only ledger.jsonl. The demo output, and so the card in README.md and docs/REPORT.md Figure 1, takes the task, agent, model, and 'recorded from ... (run at <sha>)' lines from meta.json (tools/demo.py:47-48), which no test or gate compares with the banked run.json; they agree today (for each fixture, meta.json equals record_demo.fixture_meta(<banked run>)). Asserting that equality in the same test would close it.

resolved: N27: the fake sandbox gives every command a private TMPDIR outside the host's /tmp (tests/bench/fakes.py:79-81, 98-102; tests/bench/test_fakes.py, which passed). In the full-suite prepush legs of faf22c5 (Python 3.11 and 3.12, slow tests included) every pilot validation passed, pilot-py-bizdays included; the only failure in each leg is B9's test. The B9 fix must keep it fixed.

N28 (ledger part): tests/repo_tools/test_record_demo.py test_every_demo_fixture_is_its_banked_run_unchanged compares every demo fixture's ledger with the banked run its meta.json names and with the recorded SHA-256, so G1 fails on an edited fixture ledger; it passed in the fast check, and the three ledgers are byte-identical to their banked runs (72c4d26c..., f768bfcc..., ce6fe815...). With G4 binding the golden output to tools/demo.py's output, the demo card's count now traces to a banked artifact.

N24 (i) to (l): docs/BENCH.md:34 says the pipeline checks each claim it extracts; docs/REPORT.md section 8 no longer lists the corrected files; D75 records the 25-minute CI timeout that replaced D27's ten minutes (Raj's commit 9d3be9a, whose message gives the twelve-minute suite); the step that runs make ci is named for the secrets scan (.github/workflows/ci.yml:34); the skip message no longer says CI installs Node 22 (the workflow installs none); CORRECTIONS.md:84-88 records the document changes.

N2: STATUS.md's REPORT.md word count equals G13's count at faf22c5 (7974, recomputed with G13's own method); its 'gates as a table' line now says the D73 pass moved the table; D75 records that D20's daily review cap meters headless review runs and that a subagent review runs inside the main session, which D20's last sentence (DECISIONS.md:112, recorded 2026-10-23) already implied. # Independent review of faf22c5 (gate G12)

Reviewed commit: faf22c51878296371a052c36b8966cbcf2255750 (branch claude/sweet-newton-r3x6t3). Previous review: cec67015e9575c32ec394bee9b0657767b17ff59 (SHIP, with new non-blocking N27 and N28). The working tree was clean; only committed state was examined.

## Scope

`git log cec6701..faf22c5`: 822c893 banks the review of cec6701 and logs N27 and N28; faf22c5 fixes N27 (tests/bench/fakes.py gives each command a private TMPDIR; new tests/bench/test_fakes.py), N28 (a new test in tests/repo_tools/test_record_demo.py), the N24 items (docs/BENCH.md, docs/REPORT.md section 8, a skip message in tests/bench/test_validate.py, the CI step name), and adds D75. Nothing under src/, tools/, prereg/, bench/, or artifacts/ (other than artifacts/review/) changed, nor the Makefile, pyproject.toml, or uv.lock, so every gate implementation and every banked artifact is as at cec6701.

## What I ran and recomputed

- `python tools/ship_check.py --fast`, once, under nice, on a fresh clone of faf22c5: G1 FAIL "make test failed (exit 2)"; G2 PASS; G3 FAIL "fast: make ci parts (lint, typecheck, test, demo) do not all pass"; G4 PASS (0s offline under unshare -rn, matches golden, no model calls); G5 FAIL (artifacts/e0/claim_type_counts.json missing); G6 PASS (40 tasks); G7, G8, G9 FAIL (no E1 or E4 artifacts); G10 PASS; G11 FAIL (no confirmatory artifact); G12 FAIL (the banked review is of cec6701, and code changed since); G13 PASS (REPORT.md 7974 words); G14 PASS. SHIP-CHECK-FAST (does not count): 6/14, against 8/14 at cec6701. Its sub-command logs: claimcheck PASS (45 bound numbers in docs/REPORT.md), freshness PASS (every derived artifact agrees with a fresh derivation), citecheck PASS, prereg-verify PASS (nothing frozen), secrets scan CLEAN (1903 tracked text files), budget OK (cash_usd = 0, no Claude call in the usage ledger, review cap effective 1).
- The failing test alone, in scratch clones outside the checkout: tests/bench/test_validate.py::test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default fails at faf22c5 on each of two runs and passes at cec6701.
- tools/prepush.sh for faf22c5 (started by the main session): the Python 3.11 leg ends "PREPUSH: FAIL make ci on fresh clone of faf22c5 (do not push)" with "1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped" and the same FAILED test, and the Python 3.12 leg ends the same way ("1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped", PREPUSH: FAIL, "312 exit 1"; its 4 skips are Docker tests).
- Every bound smoke number, recomputed from the 40 banked run directories (run.json and verification.json) with my own script rather than tools/smoke_outcomes.py: 40 runs; 0 of 40 tasks done, Wilson [0.000, 0.088]; 39 reports, 15 claiming success (0.385, [0.249, 0.541]); 15 false successes; 57 claims, 50 supported, 7 contradicted, 0 unverifiable; 10 of 15 false successes with no contradicted claim ([0.417, 0.848]); 23 runs stopped as finished_at_cap and 1 as max_turns; 20 Python and 20 TypeScript tasks; every run with empty conditions, mitigation none, seed 0, and one model. All equal artifacts/report/numbers.json. Hook latency from the 39 samples_s in artifacts/hook/latency.json: median 0.18 s, maximum 0.23 s, as bound. REPORT.md's word count by G13's own method: 7974, as STATUS.md says. The 7 contradicted claims are 4 feature_implemented, 1 task_complete, and the tests_added and file_modified claims of ts-parser-tests, so "most contradicted claims were feature claims" holds.
- Demo fixtures: each of the three ledgers under tests/fixtures/recorded/demo/ is byte-identical to its banked run, and each meta.json equals record_demo.fixture_meta of that banked run today.
- No em dash (literal or HTML entity) in any tracked file outside test strings; no hype word in README.md or docs/REPORT.md; no secret-shaped string in a tracked file outside tests/.
- Leakage and preregistration: there are no E0, E1, or E4 artifacts, no frozen preregistration, and no prereg/LOCK.json, so no held-out item, confirmatory run, or frozen file exists to be touched or pooled.

## Blocking

**B9 (result). The N27 fix breaks make test: the fake sandbox leaves a <workspace>.tmp directory in the validator's work root, which test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default forbids, so G1 and G3 fail at faf22c5.** tests/bench/fakes.py:79-81 sets self.tmp = workspace.parent / f"{workspace.name}.tmp", run() creates it on every command (tests/bench/fakes.py:98) and passes it as TMPDIR (:102), and nothing removes it; the validator removes only the workspace itself (src/receipts/bench/validate.py:505-521). tests/bench/test_validate.py:149-152 (test_workspaces_are_removed_by_default, not marked slow) asserts that the work root is empty after validating phases baseline and m1, and now fails with 'AssertionError: assert not [.../work/py-toy-greet-m1.tmp, .../work/py-toy-greet-baseline.tmp]'. Observed: python tools/ship_check.py --fast on a fresh clone of faf22c5 gives G1 FAIL 'make test failed (exit 2)' (1 failed, 4478 passed, 75 deselected) and G3 FAIL, 6/14 against 8/14 at cec6701; the Python 3.11 leg of tools/prepush.sh for faf22c5 ends 'PREPUSH: FAIL make ci on fresh clone of faf22c5... (do not push)' with '1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped' and the same FAILED test, and the Python 3.12 leg ends the same way ("1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped", PREPUSH: FAIL, "312 exit 1"; its 4 skips are Docker tests); the test alone fails at faf22c5 on two runs in a scratch clone and passes at cec6701. GitHub CI would fail the same way. The results this changes are reported as passing: STATUS.md:17 and :19 (G1 and G3 PASS), STATUS.md:32 and README.md:312-313 (G1 to G4 pass), docs/REPORT.md:674-679 ('Built and tested at HEAD ... make ci passes on a fresh clone on Python 3.11 and 3.12 before a push'), and docs/REVIEW_LOG.md:37-38 records this change as the N27 fix. Fix it without reopening N27 and without relaxing the test, for example by giving each command a fresh private temporary directory that the fake removes when the command ends, as the bubblewrap backend gives every command an empty private /tmp (src/receipts/sandbox/bwrap.py:7, 133).

## Resolved since the review of cec6701

- N27: the fake sandbox gives every command a private TMPDIR outside the host's /tmp (tests/bench/fakes.py:79-81, 98-102; tests/bench/test_fakes.py, which passed). In the full-suite prepush legs of faf22c5 (Python 3.11 and 3.12, slow tests included) every pilot validation passed, pilot-py-bizdays included; the only failure in each leg is B9's test. The B9 fix must keep it fixed.
- N28 (ledger part): tests/repo_tools/test_record_demo.py test_every_demo_fixture_is_its_banked_run_unchanged compares every demo fixture's ledger with the banked run its meta.json names and with the recorded SHA-256, so G1 fails on an edited fixture ledger; it passed in the fast check, and the three ledgers are byte-identical to their banked runs (72c4d26c..., f768bfcc..., ce6fe815...). With G4 binding the golden output to tools/demo.py's output, the demo card's count now traces to a banked artifact.
- N24 (i) to (l): docs/BENCH.md:34 says the pipeline checks each claim it extracts; docs/REPORT.md section 8 no longer lists the corrected files; D75 records the 25-minute CI timeout that replaced D27's ten minutes (Raj's commit 9d3be9a, whose message gives the twelve-minute suite); the step that runs make ci is named for the secrets scan (.github/workflows/ci.yml:34); the skip message no longer says CI installs Node 22 (the workflow installs none); CORRECTIONS.md:84-88 records the document changes.
- N2: STATUS.md's REPORT.md word count equals G13's count at faf22c5 (7974, recomputed with G13's own method); its 'gates as a table' line now says the D73 pass moved the table; D75 records that D20's daily review cap meters headless review runs and that a subagent review runs inside the main session, which D20's last sentence (DECISIONS.md:112, recorded 2026-10-23) already implied. STATUS.md's G1 and G3 rows are cec6701's and will need the B9 outcome; STATUS.md is allowed drift.

## Still open, non-blocking (no new id)

- N13, N18, N19, N20, N21, N22, N23, N25, N26: unchanged, since no gate code, package code, or banked artifact changed after cec6701 (evidence in the nonblocking list).
- N24 (new evidence): docs/REPORT.md:589, rewritten in faf22c5, says each CORRECTIONS.md entry names "the file and section it corrects", but CORRECTIONS.md:134 ("The headline figure") names neither, and CORRECTIONS.md:46 and :72 name no section; src/receipts/__init__.py:1 still says "check every claim", the wording corrected elsewhere.
- N28 (remaining part): the new test compares only the ledger; the card's task, agent, model, and "recorded from" lines come from each fixture's meta.json (tools/demo.py:47-48), which nothing compares with the banked run.json (they agree today).

## Notes

- Validity under D10: every non-blocking id here is already listed in docs/REVIEW_LOG.md at faf22c5, so tools/review.py --validate-only accepts this review for faf22c5 (and for a commit that changes only artifacts/review/, STATUS.md, or docs/LOG.md) and prints REVIEW: BLOCK because B9 is open. The B9 fix changes tests/, so G12 then needs a review of the fixing commit.
- faf22c5 was committed 2 minutes 26 seconds after 822c893, and its prepush started afterwards; running at least tests/bench before committing a change to a shared test helper would have caught B9.
- This is the fourth subagent review on 2026-11-25. D75 records the reading under which the effective cap of one review run a day does not apply to subagent reviews; whether section 10.1 step 8 means that cap to cover them is for Raj to confirm.

## Verdict

1. B9 (result): the N27 fix in tests/bench/fakes.py:79-81 and :98 leaves a <workspace>.tmp directory in the validator's work root, so tests/bench/test_validate.py:149-152 fails, and make test, make ci, G1, and G3 fail on a fresh clone of faf22c5 (fast check 6/14 with G1 "make test failed (exit 2)"; both prepush legs, Python 3.11 and 3.12, "1 failed, 4549 passed, 4 skipped" and PREPUSH: FAIL), while STATUS.md:17 and :19, README.md:312-313, and docs/REPORT.md:674-679 report them passing.
